title: Diagnostic estimate of tagged-PDF compilation cost
interpretation: Across three direct passes per variant, the median wall time is 51.06% lower with tagging disabled. This suggests a substantial cost associated with tagging/structure finalization on this fixture and warrants targeted profiling while preserving structure; it does not justify disabling tagging.
limitations: Three runs per variant in a fixed, only partially counterbalanced order; cache and order effects may remain.
One direct pass per run. Both variants contain unresolved page references and are diagnostic files, not final previews.
The untagged variant has no accessibility structure and is not a production candidate.
Synthetic branching fixture with no media on one macOS and TeX Live environment; no inference to all books or systems.
No PDF accessibility checker or screen-reader assessment was performed.
